title: Decomposed Trust: Exploring Privacy, Adversarial Robustness, Fairness, and Ethics of Low-Rank LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating predictive fairness using the Adult dataset from the DecodingTrust benchmark by converting tabular records (containing attributes such as age, race, sex, education, and occupation) into structured natural-language prompts and measuring Demographic Parity Difference (Mdpd) and Equalized Odds Difference (Meod) across sensitive groups.
